'Яготинське для дітей відновили своє виробництво' - the child brand, whose string contains the parent's display name, so a substring matcher scores this post twice (`yagotynske` + `yahotynske-dlia-ditei`); note the two canon ids also disagree on transliteration (yag- vs yah-). Also 'знайшла ... у новусі': the retailer NOVUS lowercased and in the locative - the declension shape a flat lexicon misses.
